mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (user_id, type, title, content, order_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{orderId}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.user_id, n.type, n.title, n.content, n.order_id, CASE WHEN nr.notification_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 WHEN n.user_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE n.status END AS status, n.create_time, o.order_no AS order_no FROM notification n LEFT JOIN notification_read nr ON nr.notification_id = n.id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN `order` o ON o.id = n.order_id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} OR n.user_id IS NULL ORDER BY n.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification n LEFT JOIN notification_read nr ON nr.notification_id = n.id AND nr.user_id = #{userId} WHERE (n.user_id = #{userId} OR n.user_id IS NULL) AND nr.notification_id IS NULL AND (n.user_id IS NULL OR n.status = 0)
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO notification_read (user_id, notification_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notificationId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO notification_read (user_id, notification_id) SELECT #{userId}, n.id FROM notification n WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} OR n.user_id IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notification WHERE user_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC
